Archival Dispatch: 13 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Orson Welles Ceiling Unlimited, Hedda Hopper with Lucille Ball, and Ray Anthony with Patti Page

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 3 min
Tags: Orson Welles, Ceiling Unlimited, Hedda Hopper, Lucille Ball, Ray Anthony, Patti Page, Andy Russell, Johnny Mercer, Arthur Smith, The Mystery Chef, Harry Richman, Lee Wiley, Elvis Presley, Speedway, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 86 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 86 recovers and dates 13 historical broadcasts spanning aviation war drama, Hollywood gossip columnists, pioneering country-pop auditions, romantic crooner variety, home-front wartime cooking, and overseas military soundtrack exclusives: 2 December 1942 dramatic broadcasts written, directed, and narrated by Orson Welles for Lockheed-Vega aircraft builders on Ceiling Unlimited, 3 spring 1940 Hollywood dispatches featuring gossip queen Hedda Hopper and rising RKO comedic talent Lucille Ball on Tonight in Hollywood, a rare 1949 Lang-Worth transcription audition co-starring bandleader Ray Anthony and young vocalist Patti Page on The Rhythm Rendezvous, Latin-pop crooner Andy Russell hosting lyricist Johnny Mercer on The Andy Russell Show (1946), guitar virtuoso Arthur Smith picking 'Peter Cottontail' on Arthur Smith's Corner Store (WBT Charlotte, 1950), wartime rationing recipes from John MacPherson on The Mystery Chef (1943), transatlantic aviator Harry Richman with jazz stylist Lee Wiley (1937), Elvis Presley's Speedway soundtrack on AFRS, and network comedy previews on The Adventures of Ozzie and Harriet.
